name: @art-pollinator/discovery-ble
description: DiscoveryPort implementation over BLE (issue #34): mutual advertise-and-scan, internally composing react-native-ble-plx (Central/scan role) and munim-bluetooth (Peripheral/advertise role — see docs/adr/0011-ble-peripheral-advertising-library.md) behind one DiscoveryPort. Depends on neither native package directly (see ble-scan-library.ts / ble-advertise-library.ts) — a real composition root supplies real instances shaped to these interfaces.
